convert_onelabel_to_multilabel: convert a single integer label mask tensor of shape HxW to a multilabel bool tensor of shape NxHxW
compute_bbox_areas: compute the areas of a set of bounding boxes provided as an xyxy tensor of shape N by 4
expand_bounding_boxes: expand a set of xyxy bounding boxes by a configurable scale factor and clamp to image boundaries
convert_masks_to_bounding_boxes: convert a set of binary or integer masks to xyxy bounding box coordinates with optional image size scaling
review_mask_utils: review the mask utility functions for converting between masks and bounding boxes and expanding bounding boxes
